location.purpose: App functionality (prayer times calculation, Qibla compass, mosque finder)
location.ephemeral_transmission: Sent as query parameters over HTTPS to api.islamic.app and nominatim.openstreetmap.org; not linked to user identity or persisted on server
location.play_console_declaration: Collected: Yes, Shared: No, Linked to identity: No, Used for tracking: No

personal_info.note: No account creation, sign-in, email, phone number, or user profiles

financial_info.note: No in-app purchases, paid features, or payment processing

health_info_womens_worship.note: Cycle dates, purity intervals, and nifas tracking stored strictly on-device in local SQLite; never transmitted off-device; no Google Health Connect integration

messages_photos_files.note: No messaging, photo gallery, or user file uploads

device_identifiers.note: No AAID/GAID, IDFA, or hardware serial tracking

analytics_diagnostics.note: No Firebase Analytics, Google Analytics, Sentry, Bugsnag, or crash trackers

encryption_in_transit.protocol: HTTPS 100% across all external endpoints in src/

data_deletion_request.mechanism: In-app Settings -> Backup & Restore -> Clear All Data wipes SQLite and AsyncStorage; Android Clear Storage wipes all container data. No remote server data exists to delete.
